case.title: Upgrade from Pro to Business
case.subject: Upgrading our plan
case.text:
Hi,

We're opening a second location next month and will have 8 staff. I think we need to move from Pro to Business. If I upgrade mid-month, do I pay the full $199 straight away or is it prorated?

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Grant Veterinary
case.why: Plan change with a pricing question; the answer (prorated, Business $199) is in the KB, so prices in the draft are grounded.

output.reply:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for getting in touch, and congratulations on the new location! Moving to Business is the right fit: Pro supports up to 5 staff, while Business supports up to 20 staff and multiple locations.

If you upgrade mid-month, you won't pay the full $199 straight away. Upgrades take effect immediately and you pay a prorated amount for the rest of your current billing period.

To upgrade, sign in as the account owner (only the owner can change the plan) and go to Settings → Billing → Change plan.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support

Business is $199/month and covers up to 20 staff and multiple locations, so it fits your plan for 8 staff across two sites (Pro is limited to 5 staff).

To upgrade, the account owner can go to Settings → Billing → Change plan. Only the owner can change the plan. I can't quote the exact prorated amount from here, but it will be calculated for the remainder of your billing period.

Slotwise Support
